corrected_findings.resolution: The original diagnostic used ordinary f32 multiplication inside the unprotected model callback. It now retains observed words as u32 and compares stored floats by to_bits, and computes its formula classification in integer arithmetic only. No observed nonfinite word is used as a floating operand. The local observer no longer needs to change rounding, masks or sticky flags, and the separate physical movement arithmetic is unchanged.

The real C reply checker receives the request stage. An offer-stage attitude-difference bit is refused because those words were not read. DIFFERS_MOTION and NO_HELD_MOTION together are refused. Class/name presence, nonrecorded zero kind/mask, recorded nonzero kind and all numeric bounds remain checked. The former impossible mask31 positive was replaced with valid stage-specific cases; Lua witness validation follows the same exact contradictions.

A separate char host_id[129] field is appended consistently in the private C request and repr(C) sys mirror, with corresponding Engine transport. C memset plus whole bounded copy carries every valid roster identity up to128 bytes with its terminator; a compile-time equality ties the limits to the actual roster domain. There is no silent127-byte skip/truncation. Nontermination/nontext/out-of-domain cases are refused;128-byte and multibyte positive cases cross the layers.

The two newly introduced literal NULs in the isolated C control were replaced with textual backslash-zero character literals. The final C control blob has zero NUL bytes. Existing unrelated source NUL qualifications were not normalized.

Documentation now declares the three additional read-only metadata reads per observation. Actual TYPE is a direct entity field, ALIVE reads the mobile alive field, and HOST_ID performs the read-only current-member lookup with its existing mapping-consistency assertion. The shared C control counts these separately. Its old physical-getter transcript is explicitly not an all-getter transcript. Only eligible non-city mobile sector candidates are observed; mobile-flagged city children are intentionally outside this observer.

The fixed formula is explicitly IEEE gradual-underflow RTZ (DAZ=FTZ=0), not arbitrary caller denormal behavior. The hardware oracle explicitly selects that masked profile then restores its saved word. Offer-level facts count stage0 observations only; attitude facts count stage1; pose_fact_observations counts both. Repeat offers of the same mobile remain repeat observations, not unique mobiles or records.

source_assessment.finding: The observer is beside existing position/motion reads and, when requested by the existing candidate dialogue, its attitude read. It copies already-read words; it does not request extra physical fields, skip a candidate, alter a first-hit decision, replace a model answer or write a pose/output. Valid unknown/unrecorded/retired/no-ID classifications remain observations rather than a missing-record physical refusal. The added observation protocol is validated; malformed observers and inconsistent mappings still fail by named boundary.

Main registers SharedMovers as another Rc handle to the exact Movers registry the movement callbacks bind, step and retire. The provider reads the current registry on each observation; it does not copy a pose cache, create/adopt a record or retire/rebind anything. Immutable try_borrow avoids a RefCell panic on an active mutable borrow, returning a named busy error. Borrowed host-ID and observation storage are copied into the synchronous bounded request before callback return; no Core pointer or allocation index crosses.

Fifteen word patterns, stage, entity type, alive and the complete semantic ID are wired through C/sys/Engine/DC/World in the same order. The appended field is inspected in both C and repr(C) Rust. The provider parses the fixed-width bit-pattern prefix before the optional full ID suffix; signed zeros and signaling-NaN payload words remain words. A no-ID question is distinguished from a named unknown identity. Actual clean Windows/native crossing of this changed ABI is still a next gate, not inferred from the source or standins.

The observer belongs to the hosted entity offer. Explicit collision-fixture retains its original body and is included in the final Linux fixture builds, including weapon+collision. This finite observer source clearance does not require a third Original Windows/native matrix before the single healthy characterization.

The integer classifier is small and separated from actual movement. Real shared C headers drive the collaborator tests, avoiding a second Core-service implementation. The extra reference-arithmetic write helper is used to set/restore test MXCSR profiles; the production host selector still changes only its existing RC bits. No old physical solver/cache was introduced for observer results.

integer_classifier_assessment.contract: For two finite IEEE f32 words, exact integer significand multiplication followed by round-toward-zero with gradual underflow; None for a nonfinite operand, which becomes a formula-difference observation. This is a reference-product diagnostic, not a new physical movement solver.
static_safety_and_math: Finite significands are at most24 bits; their exact product fits48 bits in u64. Zero returns the XOR sign, preserving signed zero.
A normal result uses a significand length1..48, giving normalization shifts -23..24. The biased exponent selects normal packing or signed maxfinite saturation for RTZ overflow.

In the subnormal branch the exponent/length inequality bounds any left shift and the retained result to23 bits. A right shift of64 or more explicitly yields signed zero, avoiding invalid shifts; other shifts truncate toward zero.
The implementation performs no floating arithmetic and is independent of caller rounding/flags/masks. Its fixed gradual-underflow result deliberately does not emulate caller DAZ/FTZ flushing.
integer_classifier_assessment.validation_scope: The focused hardware comparison covers approximately3million finite operand pairs plus explicit zero/subnormal/normal/sign/overflow/underflow cases under a stated masked RTZ, DAZ=FTZ=0 oracle. It does not enumerate every possible pair. The observation-state test covers four rounding modes x eight seeded sticky-flag patterns x two mask configurations,64 MXCSR settings, including unmasked exceptions. The eight patterns are0, the six individual flags and0x3f; not all64 flag combinations. No new full public caller-FP/x87 matrix is claimed.
